What will be installed

  • HyperVibe in Applications
  • Siri Remote Mic virtual audio device
  • On-demand microphone router and capture service
  • HyperVibe Uninstall in Applications

安装内容

  • “应用程序”文件夹中的 HyperVibe
  • Siri Remote Mic 虚拟音频设备
  • 按需启动的麦克风路由与采集服务
  • “应用程序”文件夹中的 HyperVibe Uninstall

System audio restarts briefly during installation. A 25-second safety check automatically restores the previous audio plug-in if coreaudiod becomes unstable.

安装时系统音频会短暂重启。随后进行 25 秒安全检查；若 coreaudiod 异常，会自动恢复原来的音频插件。
